The user wants UI strings for a browser store page where users can install third-party extensions (附加功能/擴充功能). Language: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan conventions).

Let me think about appropriate Taiwan-style terminology:
- Browser store page: 應用商店 or 線上應用程式商店. In browser context, "附加功能" is what Firefox uses in Taiwan ("附加元件" actually). Chrome uses "擴充功能". The user said "第三方做的附加功能來擴充瀏覽器" — so third-party extensions/add-ons.
- s1: Store page title. Something like "附加功能商店" or "擴充功能商店". Chrome Taiwan uses "線上應用程式商店" (Chrome Web Store). Firefox uses "附加元件站" (Add-ons Manager). Since user says "附加功能", I could use "附加功能商店" or "瀏覽器附加功能商店". Let me go with "附加功能商店" or maybe "擴充功能商店". The user's wording: "商店頁的標題" — title of the store page. Something like "附加功能商店". Taiwan Mozilla uses "附加元件". Chrome uses "擴充功能". Since the user said "附加功能", I'll honor their term: "附加功能商店". Maybe add a subtitle? Just a title string. "附加功能商店" is fine. Could also be "探索附加功能" style. I'll go "附加功能商店" — simple and clear.

- s2: Install button. Taiwan UI: "安裝". Could be "安裝此附加功能" but button should be concise: "安裝". Chrome uses "加至 Chrome" but generic: "安裝". I'll use "安裝".

- s3: Installation complete status text. "安裝完成" or "已安裝". Status text after install completes: "安裝完成". Firefox uses "已安裝". The prompt says "安裝完成的狀態文字" — status text showing install completed. "安裝完成" is good. Could be "附加功能已安裝". I'll use "安裝完成".

Check for prohibited terms: none used. Use 台灣 terms, avoid 當前, 默認, etc. All fine.

Output only one JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3. No other text.```json
{
  "s1": "附加功能商店",
  "s2": "安裝",
  "s3": "安裝完成"
}
```
